name: Lincoln Yards (northern parcel now rebranded 'Foundry Park')
current_value: For Foundry Park: developers are reported to contribute directly about $33M while roughly $202M of an estimated ~$235M in infrastructure costs (roads, parks, public improvements) would be reimbursed via TIF; a June 2026 Block Club Chicago report and CoStar separately cite more than $200M in public funding lined up for the project.
proposed_value: UPDATE: the ~$202M TIF figure moved from 'reported/lined up' to City Council-APPROVED on Sept 23, 2026 -- Council approved $201.6M in TIF for Foundry Park infrastructure (plus ~$33M developer/JDL-Kayne Anderson contribution, ~$235M total), including funding for a 606 Trail extension at the site. Figures are consistent with the prior estimate, just now a confirmed vote rather than a reported plan.
note: 2-source confirmed (Block Club + The Real Deal). Does not change announced_investment_usd ($3B). Separately (lower confidence, flag only): at least one trade source suggests the Phase 1 ($800M) groundbreaking, previously targeted for October 2026, may be slipping toward November 2026 -- not confirmed as having occurred either way; worth a status check next sweep rather than a status_2026 change now.

name: 1901 Project (United Center campus)
current_value: The $7B figure was first reported in July 2024 (Sportico, Sun-Times, WBEZ) when the plan was unveiled, and is unchanged through the June 2026 groundbreaking coverage. It covers the full 10-year, six-phase, 55-acre buildout (targeted completion 2040); Phase 1 alone is reported at roughly $500M. FRESH VERIFICATION (July 2026): $7B independently corroborated across ABC7, CBS Chicago, WTTW, Block Club
proposed_value: Design-revision update (not a financing change): a permit revision filed Aug 21, 2026 scraps the originally planned rooftop park/pedestrian bridge in favor of a relocated, smaller green space; the first interior renderings of the 6,000-seat music hall were released, and permits were pulled for Phase 1 construction. The $7B total figure above is unchanged.
note: 2-source confirmed (Block Club + Crain's). Optional for the maintainer -- design detail only, no dollar or status change.
